text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear position throughout: \"I'm down for driverless cars\" with conditions","quality":"stance clarity","description":"The essay states a consistent argumentative position and keeps the reader oriented to what it is defending."},{"evidence":"uses article-linked points like safety, 90% autopilot, and fuel savings","quality":"textual support","description":"The essay grounds its argument in details from the source article rather than relying only on personal opinion."},{"evidence":"paragraphs on convenience, safety, gas money, and choice","quality":"reasoned development","description":"The essay develops its case through multiple related reasons instead of repeating the same idea."},{"evidence":"\"if... then\" explanations about naps, trustworthiness, and savings","quality":"conditional reasoning","description":"The essay shows cause-and-effect thinking by explaining what would need to be true for driverless cars to be acceptable."},{"evidence":"opening, body paragraphs, and concluding restatement","quality":"organizational control","description":"The essay has a clearer overall structure that moves from introduction through supporting points to a closing conclusion."}]}
